implementation: Adds typed NumericConvert operations and a shared pure-integer i128 lowering for all 36 pairs among int32/uint32/int64/uint64/float32/float64. Existing shape/storage/runtime/task result layouts are reused; continuation kernels carry source/destination identities. Compile-time APFloat/APSInt and integer checks diagnose known-invalid values.

contract.spelling: numeric type names as ordinary unary calls; int/uint/float aliases retain 64-bit meanings
contract.integer_to_integer: preserve value or ArithmeticFault; no wrapping/saturation
contract.integer_to_float: nearest ties to even; explicit precision loss permitted
contract.float_to_integer: truncate toward zero then check range; reject NaN/infinity
contract.float_width: exact widening; nearest-even narrowing with checked finite overflow; preserve signed underflow zero
contract.identity: preserves raw bits including NaN payloads
contract.runtime_invalid: ArithmeticFault at conversion location; supervised TaskError.Fault Arithmetic

qualification.scope: Focused qualification and affected regression run, not the full 333-test suite
coverage: all 36 scalar pairs and unchanged identities, aliases, no implicit promotion
integer endpoints, powers of two and precision/halfway neighbors plus full-range random bits
all floating exponent fields with signed fraction boundaries, random bits and explicit width-conversion underflow/overflow/tie neighbors
independent __int128 range and APFloat/APSInt result/status oracle
eight ARM rounding/flush-to-zero/default-NaN environments and no FP flags
known invalid constants, bindings, expressions and chained precision-loss round trips
synchronous CLI ArithmeticFault location/exit/cleanup and artifact preservation on compile errors
all six worker result families, all 36 mixed-source named conversion pairs and direct builtin spawns
cached result bits, wrong result-layout rejection, owned tensor recovery and fresh groups
source ArithmeticFault location and absent payload
scheduler/invocation allocation injection positions 1-24 at 1/2/4 workers
worker cancellation/deadlines/admission rejection and zero live state
CPU-only scalar boundary: tensors, narrow/unimplemented types, GPU conversions and invalid arities remain rejected

remaining_gates: tensor-wide conversion source contract and qualification
